question.problem:
What is the value of $4$ raised to the power of $3?$

$4$ raised to the power of $3$ is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
We need to evaluate ${4}^{3}.$

To evaluate ${4}^{3},$ we start by writing it out with multiplication signs:

$$
{4}^{3}={{4\times 4\times 4}_{⏟}}_{3\text{ times}}
$$

Now, we compute the product. Since $4\times 4=16,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{{4\times 4}_{⏟}}_{16}\times 4 & =16\times 4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we work out $16\times 4.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,{}_{2}\,\,\,\, &  \\  & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,6\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, &  & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,6\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\,\end{aligned} \\  & \end{aligned}
$$

Since $16\times 4=64,$ we have ${4}^{3}=64.$
